workload.pre_timing_equivalence: For sizes 64, 256 and 1024, the full-ledger-clone wrapper and direct path produced equal ledger entries and cash balances.
workload.legacy_path: For every entry, clone the entire existing Ledger, apply the entry to the clone, then replace the prior Ledger.
workload.current_path: Validate and stage only affected cash, entitlement and position state, then commit the entry.

limitations: Synthetic Adjustment entries, one account and one currency; this is a scoped ledger microbenchmark, not end-to-end backtest throughput.
The old path is an in-benchmark reproduction of the prior clone-per-entry boundary around the current apply_entry implementation, not a separately compiled historical revision.
No allocator counts, representative multi-position workload, or full A-share profile measurement is included.
